title: VisualThinkingToolkit
description: JSON Schema defining the shape and structure of the Visual Thinking Toolkit dataset.

tools.description: Collection of visual thinking tools and artifacts.

categories.description: Lookup map of visual thinking categories and domain disciplines.

stages.description: Ordered progression of creative workflow stages.

VisualThinkingTool.title: VisualThinkingTool
VisualThinkingTool.description: Schema definition for a single visual thinking tool or artifact.

n.description: The title / name of the visual thinking tool or artifact.

c.description: Category identifier key linking to one of the defined category definitions.

e.description: Representative emoji icon for quick visual identification.

p.description: Core purpose and definition of why and when this artifact is used.
examples: Radiate associations outward from one central concept.
Translate script into sequential shots with framing & action.

i.description: Prerequisite inputs, raw data, or design briefs required before starting.

o.description: Deliverable outputs and tangible results produced by this artifact.

st.description: Visual layout, composition pattern, and spatial structure of the artifact.

ex.description: Real-world production use case and concrete applied scenario.
examples: Center node: eco coffee brand → branches: ritual, craft, warmth, origin, packaging.
Lighthouse sequence: wide → CU → POV → underwater shot, with camera notes.

img.description: Optional image URL providing a visual reference example.

CategoryDefinition.title: CategoryDefinition
CategoryDefinition.description: Metadata and color branding for a creative discipline / category.

n.description: Human-readable display name of the category.

c.description: Primary accent hex color code for this category.

tint.description: Subtle background tint hex or color code for badges and highlights.

WorkflowStage.title: WorkflowStage
WorkflowStage.description: The creative development stage at which this tool is predominantly utilized.
